UI.WorldCreationSeedMenuDescription: Customize your world's seed, or choose some game-changing ones!
UI.Seed_Everything: For the Worthy wasn’t enough? Featuring aspects of every other world seed combined with some brand new surprises, this world is here to break you. Get fixed, boi!
UI.Seed_Remix: A land where up is down and down is up. Turn Terraria on its head in this inverted adventure. Will you be brave enough to explore The Up?
UI.Seed_NoTraps: Whoa, Traps. Ya hate ‘em, right? I hate them myself! This world has definitely been stripped of any and all traps... we think. Maybe.
UI.Seed_ForTheWorthy: Are you Worthy? This is a world of no mercy. Forget what you know and sharpen your skills, lest you be weighed, measured, and found wanting...
UI.Seed_TheConstant: Bringing the Don’t Starve Together adventure into Terraria, can you survive persistent hunger as you seek to save Terraria? Oh, and don’t forget to stay in the light!
UI.Seed_Celebration: 10 years of Terraria! Join the party in this colorful world of whimsy – who knows, maybe the team left some gifts behind for you to open.
UI.Seed_Drunk: Crimson & Corruption? Together? Madness. This is the land of world generation gone wild, leading to a Terraria adventure like no other! Go home worldgen, you’re drunk!
UI.Seed_NotTheBees: Enter a land oozing with syrupy honey, where the buzzing of wings and the threat of venomous stingers awaits around every turn!  (Wicker helmet not included)
UI.Seed_Normal: Welcome to Terraria! Embark on your adventures with the original Terraria experience and gameplay.
UI.Seed_Skyblock: Enter a realm floating in the sky. With little to start with, you must build up your world from humble beginnings.

SecretSeedDescription.paintEverythingGray: Journey back to a more simple time, without all of those pesky colors! (World is painted gray)
SecretSeedDescription.paintEverythingNegative: Scratch that, reverse it. (World is painted negative)
SecretSeedDescription.coatEverythingEcho: Hidden in plain sight. (World is echo coated)
SecretSeedDescription.coatEverythingIlluminant: Why is it so bright in here?  (World is illuminant coated)
SecretSeedDescription.noSurface: The outside is so overrated... (World has no surface layer)
SecretSeedDescription.extraLivingTrees: What's better than a happy little tree? A whole bunch of giant Living Trees! (World has extra, much larger Living Trees)
SecretSeedDescription.extraFloatingIslands: You always did have your head in the clouds. (World has extra Floating Islands)
SecretSeedDescription.errorWorld: Cats and dogs, living together, mass hysteria! (Error world)
SecretSeedDescription.graveyardBloodmoonStart: Klaatu Verata... Necktie!  (World is filled with graveyards, starts on a Blood Moon)
SecretSeedDescription.surfaceIsInSpace: In space, no one can hear you scream. (Surface layer is higher)
SecretSeedDescription.rainsForAYear: You're going to need a bigger boat. (World has neverending rain)
SecretSeedDescription.biggerAbandonedHouses: What lost civilization built all of this? (World has larger underground cabins)
SecretSeedDescription.randomSpawn: Where the heck are we? (Starting spawn point in a random location)
SecretSeedDescription.addTeleporters: Walking is for losers. (World has teleporters scattered throughout)
SecretSeedDescription.startInHardmode: So, you have elected the way of pain... (World starts in Hardmode)
SecretSeedDescription.noInfection: Finally, we have found a cure! (World starts with no Corruption or Crimson)
SecretSeedDescription.hallowOnTheSurface: Rainbows, kittens, and death. (World has a Hallowed surface)
SecretSeedDescription.worldIsInfected: We are in some real pretty stuff now, man! (Entire world is infected by Corruption or Crimson)
SecretSeedDescription.surfaceIsMushrooms: I hear that Truffle is a really fun guy. (World has a Mushroom surface)
SecretSeedDescription.surfaceIsDesert: Like the beach with a lot less water. (World has a Desert surface)
SecretSeedDescription.pooEverywhere: Cleanup on aisle 6! (World is covered in Poo blocks)
SecretSeedDescription.noSpiderCaves: Eight legs were far too many. (World has no spider caves)
SecretSeedDescription.actuallyNoTraps: No, seriously. We mean it this time, promise! (World has no traps)
SecretSeedDescription.rainbowStuff: ROY G BIV was here. (World has all sorts of rainbow blocks and more)
SecretSeedDescription.digExtraHoles: Watch your step! (World has extra chasms and pits)
SecretSeedDescription.roundLandmasses: Aww, they look like little baby planets! (World consists of small planetoids)
SecretSeedDescription.extraLiquid: The search for Atlantis begins! (World is flooded)
SecretSeedDescription.portalGunInChests: Here Come The Test Results: 'You Are A Horrible Person.' (Portal Gun can spawn in any chest)
SecretSeedDescription.worldIsFrozen: Some people are always trying to ice skate uphill... (World consists of snow and ice)
SecretSeedDescription.halloweenGen: All we are missing now is a corn maze. (World starts with pumpkins)
SecretSeedDescription.endlessHalloween: Trick or treat! (Halloween event always active)
SecretSeedDescription.endlessChristmas: Let's see what is under the tree... (Christmas event always active)
SecretSeedDescription.vampirism: You are going to need some SPF9000. (Player is a Vampire - avoid the sun at all costs)
SecretSeedDescription.teamBasedSpawns: Stay off of our turf! (Player spawns are specific to team colors)
SecretSeedDescription.dualDungeons: Buy one Dungeon, get one free! (A dungeon crawling experience)

Achievements.NO_HOBO_Description: Build a house suitable enough for your first town NPC, such as the guide, to move into.
Achievements.OBTAIN_HAMMER_Description: Obtain your first hammer via crafting or otherwise.
Achievements.OOO_SHINY_Description: Mine your first nugget of ore with a pickaxe.
Achievements.HEART_BREAKER_Description: Discover and smash your first heart crystal underground.
Achievements.HEAVY_METAL_Description: Obtain an anvil made from iron or lead.
Achievements.I_AM_LOOT_Description: Discover a golden chest underground and take a peek at its contents.
Achievements.STAR_POWER_Description: Craft a mana crystal out of fallen stars, and consume it.
Achievements.EYE_ON_YOU_Description: Defeat the Eye of Cthulhu, an ocular menace who only appears at night.
Achievements.SMASHING_POPPET_Description: Using explosives or your trusty hammer, smash a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart in the evil parts of your world.
Achievements.WORM_FODDER_Description: Defeat the Eater of Worlds, a massive worm who dwells in the corruption.
Achievements.MASTERMIND_Description: Defeat the Brain of Cthulhu, an enormous demon brain which haunts the creeping crimson.
Achievements.WHERES_MY_HONEY_Description: Discover a large bee's hive deep in the jungle.
Achievements.STING_OPERATION_Description: Defeat the Queen Bee, the matriarch of the jungle hives.
Achievements.BONED_Description: Defeat Skeletron, the cursed guardian of the dungeon.
Achievements.DUNGEON_HEIST_Description: Steal a key from the dungeon's undead denizens, and unlock one of their precious golden chests.
Achievements.ITS_GETTING_HOT_IN_HERE_Description: Spelunk deep enough to reach the molten underworld.
Achievements.MINER_FOR_FIRE_Description: Craft a molten pickaxe using the hottest of materials.
Achievements.STILL_HUNGRY_Description: Defeat the Wall of Flesh, the master and core of the world who arises after a great, burning sacrifice.
Achievements.ITS_HARD_Description: Unleash the ancient spirits of light and darkness across your world, enabling much stronger foes and showering the world with dazzling treasures (and rainbows!).
Achievements.BEGONE_EVIL_Description: Smash a demon or crimson altar with a powerful, holy hammer.
Achievements.EXTRA_SHINY_Description: Mine a powerful ore that has been newly blessed upon your world.
Achievements.BUCKETS_OF_BOLTS_Description: Defeat the three nocturnal mechanical menaces: the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime.
Achievements.DRAX_ATTAX_Description: Craft a drax or pickaxe axe using hallowed bars, and the souls of the three mechanical bosses.
Achievements.PHOTOSYNTHESIS_Description: Mine chlorophyte, an organic ore found deep among the thickest of flora.
Achievements.GET_A_LIFE_Description: Consume a life fruit, which grows in the thick of subterranean jungle grass.
Achievements.THE_GREAT_SOUTHERN_PLANTKILL_Description: Defeat Plantera, the overgrown monstrosity of the jungle's depths.
Achievements.TEMPLE_RAIDER_Description: Breach the impenetrable walls of the jungle temple.
Achievements.LIHZAHRDIAN_IDOL_Description: Defeat Golem, the stone-faced ritualistic idol of the lihzahrd tribe.
Achievements.ROBBING_THE_GRAVE_Description: Obtain a rare treasure from a difficult monster in the dungeon.
Achievements.BIG_BOOTY_Description: Unlock one of the dungeon's large, mysterious chests with a special key.
Achievements.FISH_OUT_OF_WATER_Description: Defeat Duke Fishron, mutant terror of the sea.
Achievements.OBSESSIVE_DEVOTION_Description: Defeat the Ancient Cultist, fanatical leader of the dungeon coven.
Achievements.STAR_DESTROYER_Description: Defeat the four celestial towers of the moon.
Achievements.BLOODBATH_Description: Survive a blood moon, a nocturnal event where the rivers run red and monsters swarm aplenty.
Achievements.SLIPPERY_SHINOBI_Description: Defeat King Slime, the lord of all things slimy.
Achievements.GOBLIN_PUNTER_Description: Triumph over a goblin invasion, a ragtag regiment of crude, barbaric, pointy-eared warriors and their shadowflame sorcerers.
Achievements.WALK_THE_PLANK_Description: Triumph over a pirate invasion, a group of pillagers from the sea out for your booty... and your life!
Achievements.KILL_THE_SUN_Description: Survive a solar eclipse, a day darker than night filled with creatures of horror.
Achievements.DO_YOU_WANT_TO_SLAY_A_SNOWMAN_Name: Do You Want to Slay a Snowman?
Achievements.DO_YOU_WANT_TO_SLAY_A_SNOWMAN_Descriptio: Triumph over the frost legion, a festive family of maniacal snowman mobsters.
Achievements.TIN_FOIL_HATTER_Description: Triumph over a martian invasion, when beings from out of this world come to scramble your brains and probe you in uncomfortable places.
Achievements.BALEFUL_HARVEST_Description: Reach the 15th wave of a pumpkin moon, where evil lurks among the autumn harvest.
Achievements.ICE_SCREAM_Description: Reach the 15th wave of a frost moon, where the festive season quickly degrades into madness.
Achievements.STICKY_SITUATION_Description: Survive the slime rain, where gelatinous organisms fall from the sky in droves.
Achievements.REAL_ESTATE_AGENT_Description: Have all possible town NPCs living in your world.
Achievements.NOT_THE_BEES_Description: Fire a Bee Gun while wearing a full set of Bee Armor.
Achievements.JEEPERS_CREEPERS_Description: Stumble into a spider cavern in the underground.
Achievements.FUNKYTOWN_Description: Build or encounter a glowing mushroom field above the surface.
Achievements.INTO_ORBIT_Description: You can only go down from here!
Achievements.MECHA_MAYHEM_Description: Do battle against the Twins, the Destroyer, and Skeletron Prime simultaneously and emerge victorious.
Achievements.GELATIN_WORLD_TOUR_Description: Defeat every type of slime there is!
Achievements.FASHION_STATEMENT_Description: Equip armor or vanity clothing in all three social slots.
Achievements.VEHICULAR_MANSLAUGHTER_Description: Defeat an enemy by running it over with a minecart.
Achievements.THERE_ARE_SOME_WHO_CALL_HIM_Name: There are Some Who Call Him...
Achievements.SWORD_OF_THE_HERO_Description: Obtain a Terra Blade, forged from the finest blades of light and darkness.
Achievements.LUCKY_BREAK_Description: Survive a long fall with just a sliver of health remaining.
Achievements.DYE_HARD_Description: Equip a dye in every possible dye slot.
Achievements.FREQUENT_FLYER_Description: Spend over 1 gold being treated by the nurse.
Achievements.RAINBOWS_AND_UNICORNS_Description: Fire a rainbow gun while riding on a unicorn.
Achievements.IT_CAN_TALK_Description: Build a house in a mushroom biome and have the Truffle move in.
Achievements.WATCH_YOUR_STEP_Description: Become a victim to a nasty underground trap.
Achievements.MARATHON_MEDALIST_Description: Travel a total of 26.2 miles on foot.
Achievements.SERVANT_IN_TRAINING_Description: Complete your 1st quest for the angler.
Achievements.GOOD_LITTLE_SLAVE_Description: Complete your 10th quest for the angler.
Achievements.TROUT_MONKEY_Description: Complete your 25th quest for the angler.
Achievements.FAST_AND_FISHIOUS_Description: Complete your 50th quest for the angler.
Achievements.SUPREME_HELPER_MINION_Description: Complete a grand total of 200 quests for the angler.
Achievements.TOPPED_OFF_Description: Attain maximum life and mana possible without accessories or buffs.
Achievements.YOU_CAN_DO_IT_Description: Survive your character's first full night.
Achievements.MATCHING_ATTIRE_Description: Equip armor in all three armor slots: head, chest, and feet.
Achievements.BEHIND_THE_MASK_Description: Slay the Insane Cultist, a mad magician with powerful spells.
Achievements.DAVY_JONES_LOCKER_Description: Defeat the Flying Dutchman, the sails of the plunderin' skies.
Achievements.WINTERHEARTED_Description: Defeat the Ice Queen, wicked witch of the coldest nights.
Achievements.PUMPKIN_SMASHER_Description: Defeat the Pumpking, the spooky lord of hallow's eve.
Achievements.INDEPENDENCE_DAY_Description: Defeat a Mothership, overminds of the martian invaders.
Achievements.HEX_EDUCATION_Description: Defeat a Goblin Warlock, conjurers of the darkest flames.
Achievements.DEFEAT_EMPRESS_OF_LIGHT_Description: Defeat the Empress of Light, responsible for all those flashy lights and glitter.
Achievements.DEFEAT_QUEEN_SLIME_Description: Defeat Queen Slime, giving the coup-de-grace to the sovereign of all that jiggles.
Achievements.DEFEAT_DREADNAUTILUS_Description: Defeat the Dreadnautilus, murderous mollusk lurking beneath the surface of the sanguine seas.
Achievements.DEFEAT_OLD_ONES_ARMY_TIER3_Description: Repel the strongest forces the Old One's Army can muster.
Achievements.GET_ZENITH_Description: Obtain the Zenith, the culmination of a journey forged into the ultimate sword.
Achievements.GET_TERRASPARK_BOOTS_Description: Obtain the Terraspark Boots, forged from the finest boots of fire and ice.
Achievements.FLY_A_KITE_ON_A_WINDY_DAY_Description: Fly a kite on a windy day.
Achievements.FOUND_GRAVEYARD_Description: Enter a misty graveyard filled with the surly dead.
Achievements.GO_LAVA_FISHING_Description: Drop a lure in a pool of lava for a pre-fried haul!
Achievements.TURN_GNOME_TO_STATUE_Description: Trick a gnome into turning into stone!
Achievements.TALK_TO_NPC_AT_MAX_HAPPINESS_Description: Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!
Achievements.PET_THE_PET_Description: Deliver headpats to the town pet.
Achievements.THROW_A_PARTY_Description: What you're celebrating doesn't matter, just throw a party already!
Achievements.DIE_TO_DEAD_MANS_CHEST_Description: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could open the chest that you didn't stop to think if you should.
Achievements.GET_GOLDEN_DELIGHT_Description: Obtain Golden Delight, the highest quality meal made from the highest quality... ingredients.
Achievements.GET_CELL_PHONE_Description: Obtain the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.
Achievements.GET_ANKH_SHIELD_Description: Obtain the Ankh Shield, the finest protection from unpleasant maladies and ailments.
Achievements.GAIN_TORCH_GODS_FAVOR_Description: Invoked the wrath of the God of Torches, and survived long enough to earn its blessing.
Achievements.PLAY_ON_A_SPECIAL_SEED_Description: Some very special seeds can lead to unique and rewarding experiences. Can you find one?
Achievements.DEFEAT_DEERCLOPS_Description: Defeat Deerclops, the chilly one-eyed monstrosity from a foreign land.
Achievements.DRINK_BOTTLED_WATER_WHILE_DROWNING_Descr: Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.
Achievements.ALL_TOWN_SLIMES_Description: Find all of the Slime Pets and have them move in!
Achievements.TRANSMUTE_ITEM_Description: Shimmer an item into another item. What other transmutations can you find?
Achievements.PURIFY_ENTIRE_WORLD_Description: Completely purify all Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow from your world, until the Dryad is satisfied!
Achievements.TO_INFINITY_AND_BEYOND_Description: Fly a Kwad Racer into outer space.
Achievements.BOOK_WORM_Description: Catalogue every creature in the world.
Achievements.BOULDER_LORD_Description: Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.
Achievements.QUEEN_MACHINE_Description: Defeated the combined form of the 3 mechanical giants.
Achievements.ROLLIN_IN_YOUR_GRAVE_Description: Take a ride in your final resting place.
Achievements.FEAR_THE_SUN_Description: Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.
Achievements.ITS_SHALING_OUTSIDE_Description: Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.
Achievements.EXTRA_LIFE_Description: Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.
Achievements.GRAVE_MISTAKE_Description: “Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.
Achievements.SPICY_LICKS_Description: Jam out on a six stringed instrument.
Achievements.ORGANIZED_CHAOS_Description: Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.
Achievements.ON_FLEEK_Description: Spot the sun on a “cool” day.
Achievements.TRAINING_DAY_Description: Get your villagers fully combat ready.
Achievements.TERRARIST_Description: Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.
Achievements.NEW_DIGS_Description: Give any villager a new look.
Achievements.MY_PEOPLE_NEED_ME_Description: Embark on a one way trip into outer space.
Achievements.GOING_OLDSCHOOL_Description: Bring back the original title screen.
Achievements.SEA_YOU_LATER_Description: Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.
Achievements.TRASH_COMPACTOR_Description: Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.
Achievements.CONSERVATIONIST_Description: Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.
Achievements.INTERDIMENSIONAL_RECYCLING_Description: Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.

LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.1: Find the stylist to try out even more hairstyles, and hair dyes!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.2: Everything can be changed after character creation - Finding the Stylist, dresser, and other various items.
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.3: Color any armor & accessory with dye, switch it freely!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.4: There's a certain rare shampoo that will make your hair sparkle, down to the scalp!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.5: Hide any equipped accessory if you'd like - it still works!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.6: If you like an item's look, equip it in a vanity slot - You'll retain your armor's benefits, fashionably!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.7: Certain items change your voice, don't bawk about it.
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.8: If you find a strange plant, give it to the dye trader - for awesome dyes!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.9: Try a new look every day at the dresser - it can also store items for your various looks!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.10: The Dye Trader can help you mix dyes to combine their effects!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.11: Turn rare colorful material in your adventures into dye, at the dye vat.
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.12: Even golfballs & strings can be dyed at the dye vat.
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.13: The clothier offers familiar clothes, they hide any armor while retaining its benefits!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.14: Craft the mannequin & womannequin to show off your gear.
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.15: Accessorize your look with plentiful items, most of them can be worn together, and over each other!
LoadingTips_CharacterCreation.16: If you'd like to hide your helmet, obtain the familiar wig from the Clothier!

LoadingTips_Default.1: Other players can loot your chests! If you don't trust them, use a Safe or Piggy Bank; those items have storage that is exclusive to each player.
LoadingTips_Default.2: Info accessories don't need to be equipped to provide you and nearby friends with useful information; you can just leave them in your Inventory.
LoadingTips_Default.3: Rope can really help you get around while exploring caves. You can even craft it into a Rope Coil which can be thrown and automatically unfolds!
LoadingTips_Default.4: Mushroom Biomes can be grown above ground as well as below. Friendly Truffles will sometimes make themselves at home in Surface Mushroom Biomes.
LoadingTips_Default.5: You can change your spawn point by placing and using a bed.
LoadingTips_Default.6: If you find a Magic Mirror, you can use it to teleport back to your spawn point.
LoadingTips_Default.7: There are Floating Islands in the sky.
LoadingTips_Default.8: Sometimes you can find NPCs hidden around the World.
LoadingTips_Default.9: During a Blood Moon, Zombies can open doors.
LoadingTips_Default.11: Torches and Glowsticks can be a light for you in dark places when all other lights go out. Torches won't work underwater, but Glowsticks will.
LoadingTips_Default.12: Don't fall into lava without drinking an Obsidian Skin Potion first!
LoadingTips_Default.13: You won't take falling damage if you have a Lucky Horseshoe. Look for them in chests found on Floating Islands.
LoadingTips_Default.14: Walking on Hellstone and Meteorite can burn you! Protect yourself by equipping an Obsidian Skull or similar accessory.
LoadingTips_Default.15: Life Crystals are hidden around the World. Use them to increase your health.
LoadingTips_Default.16: Torches require Wood and Gel to craft. Gel can be obtained by defeating slimes.
LoadingTips_Default.17: Some ores require better pickaxes to mine.
LoadingTips_Default.18: Bosses are easier to defeat with friends.
LoadingTips_Default.19: Bows and guns require the proper ammo in your Ammo Slots.
LoadingTips_Default.20: The Old Man at the Dungeon is a Clothier. If only someone could lift his curse...
LoadingTips_Default.21: Merchants love money. If you save up enough, one might move in!
LoadingTips_Default.22: Keep an explosive in your inventory or a storage container to attract a Demolitionist to your house.
LoadingTips_Default.23: Make sure you have valid housing with empty rooms, and you may attract new inhabitants to your World.
LoadingTips_Default.24: When exploring, it helps to keep some Platforms on hand. They can be crafted from numerous materials such as Wood, Glass, or even Bones.
LoadingTips_Default.25: Slay a boss to attract a Dryad to your house. She can tell you the state of Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow in your World.
LoadingTips_Default.26: Advanced players may wish to remap their buttons; you can do this from the Controls Menu in Settings.
LoadingTips_Default.27: Wear a Mining Helmet if you don't want to use Torches.
LoadingTips_Default.28: You can wear Buckets on your head!
LoadingTips_Default.29: Defeat the boss in The Underworld to change the World forever. Find a Guide Voodoo Doll and hurl it into the infernal lava to summon him.
LoadingTips_Default.30: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars can't be destroyed with a normal hammer. You have to pwn them.
LoadingTips_Default.32: Falling Stars sometimes appear at night. Collect 5 of them to craft a Mana Crystal you can use to increase your Mana.
LoadingTips_Default.34: A pet can be your best friend.
LoadingTips_Default.35: If you dig deep enough, you'll end up in The Underworld!
LoadingTips_Default.36: Santa Claus is real. He comes to town after the Frost Legion is defeated (and 'tis the season).
LoadingTips_Default.37: Don't shake a Snow Globe unless you want to summon the Frost Legion.
LoadingTips_Default.38: You can use Hallowed Seeds, Holy Water, or Pearlstone to make Hallow spread.
LoadingTips_Default.39: The Hallow is the only place where Corruption and Crimson cannot spread.
LoadingTips_Default.40: The Corruption is full of chasms. Mind the gaps.
LoadingTips_Default.42: You can plant Acorns to grow new trees.
LoadingTips_Default.43: Rocket science gave us Rocket Boots.
LoadingTips_Default.44: The Cloud in a Bottle and Shiny Red Balloon accessories both improve your ability to jump. Combine them to make a Cloud in a Balloon.
LoadingTips_Default.45: If you store your Coins in a Chest or Piggy Bank, you will be less likely to lose them.
LoadingTips_Default.46: To craft potions, place a Bottle on a Table to make an Alchemy Station. Double, double, toil and trouble!
LoadingTips_Default.47: If your house doesn't have background walls, monsters will be able to spawn inside.
LoadingTips_Default.48: Wearing a full set of armor crafted from the same material gives you an extra bonus.
LoadingTips_Default.49: Build a Furnace to craft metal bars out of ore.
LoadingTips_Default.50: You can harvest Cobwebs and turn them into Silk. You can use Silk to craft beds, sofas, and more!
LoadingTips_Default.51: You can buy Wires from the Mechanic and use them to create traps, pumping systems, or other elaborate devices.
LoadingTips_Default.52: The Housing section of the Equipment Menu allows you to decide what rooms you want your NPCs to live in.
LoadingTips_Default.53: If you're sick of getting knocked around, try equipping a Cobalt Shield. You can find one in the Dungeon.
LoadingTips_Default.54: Grappling Hooks are invaluable tools for exploration. Try crafting them with Hooks or gems.
LoadingTips_Default.55: A room in a house can have Wood Platforms as a floor or ceiling, but NPCs need at least one solid block to stand on.
LoadingTips_Default.56: You can destroy Shadow Orbs and Crimson Hearts with a hammer or explosives, but prepare yourself for the forces they unleash.
LoadingTips_Default.57: When dealing with a Goblin Army, crowd control is key.
LoadingTips_Default.58: The best wizards around use Mana Flowers.
LoadingTips_Default.59: Use "suspicious looking items" at your own risk!
LoadingTips_Default.61: The Goblin Tinkerer found in Underground Caverns will sell you many useful items, including a Tinkerer's Workshop.
LoadingTips_Default.62: You can check if a room is valid housing from the Housing section of the Inventory Menu.
LoadingTips_Default.63: Seeds can be used to grow a variety of useful ingredients for crafting potions.
LoadingTips_Default.65: If you get lost or need to find another player, open the World Map.
LoadingTips_Default.66: If you need to remove background walls, craft a hammer!
LoadingTips_Default.67: Got some extra walls or platforms? You can turn them back into their original materials!
LoadingTips_Default.68: Fishing is a fantastic source of crafting ingredients, accessories, and loot crates!
LoadingTips_Default.69: Nothing improves your mobility like Wings. Who wouldn't want to fly?
LoadingTips_Default.70: Riding Minecarts is one of the best ways of getting around. You can build your own tracks, or find them Underground.
LoadingTips_Default.71: Life Crystals not enough for you? Eventually, Life Fruit will grow in the Jungle, and can give you an extra boost to your health.
LoadingTips_Default.72: Change your clothes in game at a Dresser or talk to the Stylist for a new hairdo.
LoadingTips_Default.73: Mounts grant the player increased mobility and a variety of useful abilities. Each one is unique!
LoadingTips_Default.74: Looking for a challenge? Try Expert mode!
LoadingTips_Default.75: Be careful around Martian Probes. If they scan you, they'll summon a Martian Invasion!
LoadingTips_Default.76: During a Solar Eclipse, be on the lookout for tons of strange and creepy monsters.
LoadingTips_Default.77: Sometimes, enemies may even invade from other dimensions...
LoadingTips_Default.78: A Pumpkin Medallion can be used to summon the Pumpkin Moon. Spooky!
LoadingTips_Default.79: Feeling up for the chill of winter? Use a Naughty Present to summon the Frost Moon!
LoadingTips_Default.80: When a Sandstorm hits, deserts can be very dangerous. New enemies, reduced visibility, and it can even be hard to move!
LoadingTips_Default.81: The Arms Dealer knows more about guns than anyone. If you find one, he might move in.
LoadingTips_Default.82: The Mechanic got lost in the Dungeon. You'll have to help her out if you want her to move in.
LoadingTips_Default.83: Once you use a Life Crystal, a Nurse might move in! Speak to her for healing at any time... for a price, of course.
LoadingTips_Default.84: If you ever want to get stylish, try dyes! The Dye Trader can help you turn some materials into new dye colors.
LoadingTips_Default.85: The Tavernkeep is a guest from a faraway land called Etheria.
LoadingTips_Default.86: If you need a new haircut, go check out a nearby Spider Biome. Stylists always end up lost in them!
LoadingTips_Default.87: Regular Wood and Stone not vibrant enough for you? A Painter will move in and sell paints if enough townsfolk move in.
LoadingTips_Default.88: It's worth it to explore your Oceans. You can find treasure, dyes, and even sleeping fishermen.
LoadingTips_Default.89: You could get a Witch Doctor to come to your World if you defeat the Queen Bee.
LoadingTips_Default.90: The Party Girl won't move in unless your World is full of other townsfolk. Afterall, what's a party without lots of guests?
LoadingTips_Default.91: The Wizard sells some useful magic artifacts, but he has a tendency to wander off Underground.
LoadingTips_Default.92: The Tax Collector spends his days wandering the Underworld as a Tortured Soul. If only there were a way to purify him...
LoadingTips_Default.93: Pirates are so unpredictable. First they invade your world, and then they move into your houses!
LoadingTips_Default.94: If you ever defeat any giant robots, a Steampunker might move in to your World.
LoadingTips_Default.95: If you like rockets, the Cyborg may have some for sale.
LoadingTips_Default.96: The Traveling Merchant never stays in one place for long, but he always brings different wares when he visits!
LoadingTips_Default.97: Not all Skeletons are evil. Some are even known to sell unique items to those that can find them.
LoadingTips_Default.98: Not sure what to do next? Take a look at the Achievement Guide for a clue!
LoadingTips_Default.99: If an enemy steals your money after you die in Expert Mode, hunt it down! If you defeat it, you can get your money back.
LoadingTips_Default.100: With the Block Swap mechanic enabled, you can replace one block with another directly, rather than having to mine it first.
LoadingTips_Default.101: Keep an eye out for Goodie Bags around Halloween. If you open them, you can find all sorts of spooky items.  Trick or Treat!
LoadingTips_Default.102: Clouds are nice and soft, and you won't get hurt falling on them no matter how far you fall.
LoadingTips_Default.103: Did you know you can order your Summons to attack a specific target? While holding a Summoning Weapon, Right Click an enemy!
LoadingTips_Default.104: Press the + and - keys to zoom in & out! Focus on what matters!
LoadingTips_Default.105: Have something on the Map to show a friend? Double click on the Map to ping a location for everyone to see!
LoadingTips_Default.106: The Void Bag is a magical artifact that will store items for you when your inventory is full.
LoadingTips_Default.107: Enemies aren't the only danger when exploring Underground. Watch out for traps too!
LoadingTips_Default.108: Find a cool new Material?  Want to know what you can make?  Check with your friendly neighborhood Guide!
LoadingTips_Default.109: Have some NPCs perished?  Don't worry, they'll be back in the morning.

LoadingTips_GamePad.0: You can assign your favorite items to the DPad for rapid use by enabling DPad Hotbar in Gamepad Settings!
LoadingTips_GamePad.1: You can continuously use some items by holding down the {InputTrigger_UseOrAttack} button.
LoadingTips_GamePad.2: Press {InputTrigger_SmartCursor} to switch between Cursor Modes.
LoadingTips_GamePad.3: If your Inventory is full, you can press {InputTriggerUI_Trash} to send items to the Trash.
LoadingTips_GamePad.4: When speaking to a vendor, you can sell items in your Inventory by pressing {InputTriggerUI_Trash}.
LoadingTips_GamePad.5: You can remove Torches with {InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} or with a pickaxe.
LoadingTips_GamePad.6: In your Inventory, you can press {InputTrigger_QuickEquip} to equip items such as armor or accessories directly to a usable slot.
LoadingTips_GamePad.7: Hold {InputTrigger_SmartSelect} to use Auto Select, a versatile feature that adapts to your environment. It will allow you to automatically hold your Torches in dark caves, Glowsticks when underwater, or even select the right tool for breaking something.
LoadingTips_GamePad.8: Press {InputTriggerUI_FavoriteItem} to Favorite an item. Favorited items can no longer be sold, thrown away, or dropped. No more accidentally losing your favorite items!
LoadingTips_GamePad.9: While navigating your Inventory, press {InputTriggerUI_BuildFromInventory} while highlighting a tool or block to build directly from your Inventory.
LoadingTips_GamePad.10: Hold {InputTrigger_RadialQuickbar} and {InputTrigger_RadialHotbar} to bring up the Radial Quickbar and Radial Hotbar menus. These will allow you to quickly access potions, mounts, and the items in your hotbar.
LoadingTips_GamePad.11: There are multiple Gamepad control layouts available in the menu. Choose from Redigit's Pick, Yoraiz0r's Pick, Xbox, Playstation, or even make your own Custom settings!
LoadingTips_GamePad.12: If you select DPad Cursor Snap in the Gamepad settings, you can use the DPad for improved precision when mining or building.
LoadingTips_GamePad.13: When using Gamepad, you can lock on to enemies by pressing {InputTrigger_LockOn}. Locked on targets will be marked by a spinning reticle, and long range weapons will automatically aim at your target!
LoadingTips_GamePad.14: You can assign or remove NPCs from houses! From the housing interface, {InputTrigger_UseOrAttack} to assign them to a home, and {InputTrigger_InteractWithTile} their banner to kick them out!

Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Goblins: A ragtag army of crude, barbaric goblins set out to conquer and destroy. Some wield dark, evil magic.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Pirates: A seafaring horde of armed bandits that lust after the riches of the land, collecting treasures and taking no prisoners.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Martian: Technologically advanced beings from another world who want to eradicate all primitive life with their superior weaponry.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_OldOnesArmy: Minions from Etheria - they may have mistakenly invaded this world, but they wish to rule it nonetheless!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_PumpkinMoon: A bitter harvest rises in the dead of night. Creatures of evil and darkness spook the lands, killing everything in their path.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_FrostMoon: Ho Ho Ho! On this not-so-silent night, festive beings wish to shower the world with gifts of blood and carnage.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_FrostLegion: This organized family of cold-hearted killers wish to ice any who cross them, and they don't like snitches... capisce?
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_SlimeRain: For reasons beyond any meteorological explanation, slimy things are raining down from above by the buckets!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_WindyDay: Don't get carried away! Nature is throwing a party and wishes to sweep everybody - and everything - off their feet!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_BloodMoon: When the moon rises drenched in blood, the dead rise with it! These macabre creatures seek to add fresh meat to their dripping ranks.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Halloween: Pumpkins grow wildly across the land, and certain creatures masquerade in unusual costumes. Trick or treat!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Rain: When it rains, it pours. Creatures which normally thrive in water may roam the land and sky. Beware the angered clouds.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Christmas: Winter is here! Time to celebrate with twinkling lights, ugly sweaters, and a fat old fellow wearing a bright red suit.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Eclipse: Familiar creatures of horror rapidly grip the lands this day, for no mere mortal can resist the evil of the blackened sun.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Party: This day, for no particular reason, everyone decided to throw a party. There's always time for a celebration!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Blizzard: The most vile, stone-cold entities emerge in the blinding chaos of bone-piercing icy wind and snow. Every step is cold and dangerous.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Sandstorm: The sands of the desert rage like a stormy sea, with deadly creatures swimming among them.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Surface: Anywhere where one can see the trees, the mountains, and the sky. Not all creatures are powerful or even hostile.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Graveyard: When areas of death become littered with graves, a thick mist of concentrated eeriness blankets the land.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundJungle: The tangled world beneath the muddy jungle proves perilous to any adventurer. Within, be on guard for voracious plants and bugs.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_TheUnderworld: A doomed haven of fire and brimstone - run rampant with demons and devils - offers no sanctuary for the living.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_TheDungeon: Constructed long ago as a once thriving city, this dark and evil place now serves as the home for its cursed former inhabitants.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_TheCorruption: A cancerous Corruption thriving off the sins of the living. Its sole desire is to consume all things, leaving behind only a lifeless void.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Underground: Just below the surface, there's no shortage of dirt. Basic ore, mundane treasure, and weak monsters live down there.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_TheHallow: A divine and overzealous force, 'The Hallow', serves as a cure to combat evil with its majestic, powerful creatures of light.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundMushroom: A curious deviation of nature, large mushrooms grow densely from glowing blue grass. Tough 'mycanoids' defend the area.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_StardustPillar: A blue lunar seal protected by powerful guardians. This one representing a glittering celestial remnant known as 'stardust'.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Jungle: Thick trees, brambled vines, and relentless beasts of nature inhabit this dense canopy of lush growth, sprouted from seemingly limitless mud.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Caverns: Tough monsters, abandoned cabins, and golden treasure adorn the dark, vacant caverns tunneled beneath the underground.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundSnow: Tunnels carved throughout frigid ice result in slippery pitfalls and freezing pools - all patrolled by the sub-zero denizens of the deep.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Ocean: An endless ocean stretched to the horizon awaits at the world's edge, filled with infinitely hungry creatures from the watery depths.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_SurfaceMushroom: Surface mushroom patches must be cultivated by hand, but doing so may draw attention from strong mycanoids.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundDesert: Beneath the sandy surface lies weathered, hard sandstone.  Massive nests of deadly insects and more infest these ancient burrows.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Snow: A persistent arctic jet stream left a part of the world permanently cold. Only the hardiest of beasts can survive this harsh region.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Desert: Endless dunes of sand reside here, scorched by the never-ending sun. Few things have adapted to survive in this environment.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Meteor: The fragments left behind from plummeting meteorites burn endlessly with astrological energy, some of which appears to be alive.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Oasis: This is no mirage! The clandestine pools of water glittering in the desert sun are the only source of life in these desolate sands.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_SpiderNest: In this deadly place, there lurk arachnids with many legs, many eyes, and a thirst for blood. They sow thick webs threaded with malice.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Crimson: A hive mind of grotesque, biological infections which aim to consume all life whilst feeling absolutely nothing.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_SolarPillar: A red lunar seal protected by powerful guardians. This one representing a flaming celestial event known as 'solar flares'.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_VortexPillar: A green lunar seal protected by powerful guardians. This one representing a deep celestial void known as 'vortex'.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_TheTemple: Stone-crafted with an ancient mineral alloy, this indomitable temple houses the Lihzahrd; a crude, yet advanced reptilian race.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundCorruption: With the ancient spirits of light and dark released, the Corruption's reach drastically increased and its minions greatly empowered.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_NebulaPillar: A purple lunar seal protected by powerful guardians. This one representing a stormy celestial body known as 'nebula'.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CorruptUndergroundDesert: The Corruption's hold in the sandstone weakened the seals that held an assortment of ancient magicked beings at bay.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CrimsonUndergroundDesert: The Crimson's bloody veins broke up the tombs that once held magicked beings, which are now released to commit mayhem.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_HallowUndergroundDesert: The blessing swept through the ancient sands, awakening dangerous creatures once forgotten to time.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CorruptDesert: When the Corruption grows through the desert, vile things long since buried in the sand awaken with pure malice.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_HallowDesert: As the Hallow responds to the encroaching evils, it inadvertently awakens things that have slept beneath the sands for centuries.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CrimsonDesert: With the Crimson seeping through the sands, dark things long forgotten rise again to seek out and destroy life.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Granite: A glistening, dark material adorns the caverns here. Granite paves the way for progress in architectural fashion and durable monsters.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundCrimson: With the ancient spirit of darkness released, the Crimson's veiny growth reaches new depths, and its macabre fiends gain strength.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_UndergroundHallow: With the evils now unleashed into the depths of the world, the Hallow fights back with powerful minions of light.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Marble: A smooth material wrought with pleasing veins of color coat the walls of this cavern. An ancient civilization of monsters dwell here.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CorruptIce: Cold ice infused with even colder Corruption results in bitterly-frozen terrors lurking beneath the treacherous icy caverns.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_HallowIce: Ice serves as a catalyst for the blessing, the Hallow's luminous source of power. Strong entities take advantage of this light.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_CrimsonIce: These bitterly cold caverns of ice, saturated with the blood of Crimson, host a new variety of menacing frozen fiends.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_Sky: It is rumored that there is a land far above the clouds, where ancient treasures are guarded by powerful winged creatures.
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_DayTime: After 4:30am, the sun rises in the sky and the most dangerous of beings flee from the light. It's a great time to explore!
Bestiary_BiomeText.biome_NightTime: After 7:30pm, the moon rises in the sky. All manner of evil things, living and dead, roam the lands in the dark.

CommonBestiaryFlavor.Slime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.DemonEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Hornet: Aggressive flying insects which swarm the jungle depths. Their venomous barbs discharge over great distances at high velocity.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Zombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Skeleton: Who needs muscles, skin, or even eyeballs? Skeletons get by with just the bones on their back, just as deadly as more fleshy foes.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.GoldCritter: Rarely, critters are found coated entirely in gold! Shopkeepers will pay handsomely for these, or you can show them off in cages!
CommonBestiaryFlavor.GoldBaitCritter: Rarely, critters are found coated entirely in gold! They are worth great coin to shopkeepers and fish absolutely love golden bait!
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Jellyfish: That strange tingling sensation in the water may be the unwelcome surging of electrical death from a brainless jellyfish. Swim with care.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Pigron: This elusive dragon-pig hybrid has excellent stealth capabilities despite its rotund figure. It is uncertain how they came to exist.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Dragonfly: A swift-flying insect which hunts mosquitoes. Comes in a variety of colors. Fish are somewhat attracted to these.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Mimic: Talking to a chest doesn't cause craziness, but if the chest answers back, it may cause death! It still contains rare treasure, regardless!
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Penguin: Penguins make their home in the coldest regions of the world, waddling around looking for tasty fish.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.LavaBat: What's worse than a rabid, fast-flying, and annoying flying rodent? One that is on fire, of course!
CommonBestiaryFlavor.AngryBones: Cursed with undeath, the former inhabitants of the Dungeon roam endlessly through its halls, seeking a victim for their unending fury.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.RustyArmoredBones: Through use and neglect, the Rusted Company's weapons are jagged and rough, inflicting terrible bleeding wounds upon their foes.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.BlueArmoredBones: Disciplined and relentless, the Marching Bones unceasingly pursue their goals, sundering anything, or anyone, in their way.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.HellArmoredBones: The fiery glow of the Molten Legion is unmistakable. With their red-hot armaments in hand, they blaze a trail through all those in their way.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.RaggedCaster: With their cursed magic, the members of the Ragged Brotherhood leave their victims helplessly lost in utter darkness.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Necromancer: In life, these sorcerers bore the Necromantic Sign of their order, and they shall continue to do so forever... even in death.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Diabolist: The undead who bear the Diabolic Sigil wield flames as intense as any in the underworld, consuming all in a scorching inferno.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.MushroomZombie: The fungus controlling the minds of these zombies wants only one thing: brains! This is very convenient for the zombie.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.CostumeDemonEye: No one knows who dressed these demon eyes up in cute costumes, but the whole process hasn't made them any friendlier.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.CostumeZombie: Wearing costumes isn't fooling anyone; these zombies are clearly way too old to be trick or treating.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.CostumeSkeleton: Skeletons need to wear very elaborate costumes during Halloween, or else people think they are dressing up as skeletons.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.ZombieXmas: Even zombies can celebrate the holidays. Their festive outfits are just right, but their holiday spirit could use some work.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.RibbonSlime: A perfectly gift wrapped bundle of slime. A wonderfully deadly present for any festive occasion.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.ZombieElf: Elves that used to work for Santa, but have since been zombified. They don't complain much, so they are still pretty good helpers.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.AntlionCharger: The soldiers of the antlion species, Antlion Chargers ferociously chase after intruders with a surprising speed.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.AntlionSwarmer: Antlion Swarmers patrol their nests with a watchful eye. Should anyone threaten their eggs, they will defend them fiercely.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Scarecrow: Possessed by vengeful spirits of the harvest, these scarecrows are out to cause mischief and mayhem galore.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.FungiBulb: When the glowing fungus is ready to spread, these bulbs will sprout to spread its spores to other locations and hosts.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Mummy: With the sands transmogrified by outside forces, those put to rest in the desert, whether good or evil, now rise to maim and kill.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Sandshark: In ancient times, a saltwater river once ran through the desert. These powerful creatures evolved to survive in the now dry sand.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.Lamia: By the time glowing red eyes appear in the darkness of the desert caves, it is already too late. The lamias have found their prey.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.GemSquirrel: Glistening squirrels who strayed too deep become ensorcelled with residual cursed energy retained in gemstones.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.GemBunny: These colorful rabbits made their way so deep, their reaction to magicked gems resulted in a coveted sparkling appearance.
CommonBestiaryFlavor.TownSlime: Where did these sentient slimes come from? It is a secret to everybody, but they are certainly oozing with personality!

Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BabySlime: Clinging tightly to their parents and rarely seen, these miniature slimes will swarm anyone who harms their mother.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_MotherSlime: Critical to the lifecycle of the slime species, these oversized jiggling masses are often found carrying their young deep underground.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_JungleSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_YellowSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_RedSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PurpleSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BlackSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Pinky: The smallest slime ever recorded, their extreme cellular density makes them incredibly durable for their small size. They eat money.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GreenSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Slimeling: The still-animate severed pieces of an injured Corrupt Slime, Slimelings can still put up a fight, and have strength in numbers.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BlueSlime: A simple, gelatinous creature that swallows anything and everything whole! It takes a long time to digest anything.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DemonEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Zombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TorchZombie: In life, this torch-wielding zombie joined an angry mob to hunt the undead. In death, it joined an undead mob to hunt the living.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_EyeofCthulhu: A piece of Cthulhu ripped from his body centuries ago in a bloody war. It wanders the night seeking its host body... and revenge!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ServantofCthulhu: Young Demon Eyes newly birthed from the Eye of Cthulhu, brought forth to protect their master by any means necessary.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_EaterofSouls: Birthed from the Corruption as a being of pure malice, its sole instincts are to pursue, punish, and kill.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DevourerHead: Worm-like monstrosities are the Corruption's most favored creatures, tunneling underneath unsuspecting victims.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GiantWormHead: These itty bitty diggy dawgs dig through the earth and take focused spelunkers by surprise, causing unwanted distress.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_EaterofWorldsHead: Conceived from the bottomless malice of the Corruption, this mighty abyssal worm tunnels wildly to devour all in its path.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Merchant: The Merchant acts as a simple general store of sorts, providing useful starter tools and supplies needed for exploration.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Nurse: The Nurse's snarky attitude and poor bedside manner may be scary, but for a price, she will cure all that ails a wounded Terrarian.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ArmsDealer: The Arms Dealer has everything anyone could need to shoot things dead, from little round bullets to guns made from sharks.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Dryad: The Dryad is the last of her kind. She is connected with nature and can analyze its purity worldwide. She sells seeds, too!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Skeleton: Who needs muscles, skin, or even eyeballs? Skeletons get by with just the bones on their back, just as deadly as more fleshy foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SkeletonArcher: Skeleton Archers have a keen eye, despite the general lack of eyes. Distance offers little protection from their blazing arrows.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ArmoredSkeleton: Remnants of a long lost expeditionary force, these stout warriors mindlessly patrol the caves in which they died.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Guide: The Guide always offers useful advice and crafting recipes. His origins and unusual connections to this world remain a mystery.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_MeteorHead: When meteorites strike the surface, their fragments lay scattered for the taking. Some pieces are alive, and will attack.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_FireImp: A lesser demon imbued with hell magic. Capable of teleporting and hurling phantom fireballs towards their foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinPeon: Common footsoldiers of the Goblin Army, these foul creatures are good for little more than cannon fodder... and breaking down doors.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinThief: Quick strike units of the Goblin Army, these pesky foes specialize in nimble movement and close-quarters combat.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinWarrior: The backbone of the Goblin Army infantry, these heavily-armored soldiers can take tremendous damage as they march undeterred.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinSorcerer: As primitive as they are, some goblins have the potential for manipulating magicked shadow energy through a form of hexing.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_AngryBones: Cursed with undeath, the former inhabitants of the Dungeon roam endlessly through its halls, seeking a victim for their unending fury.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DarkCaster: Doomed to watch over the Dungeon, these mages teleport to confuse their prey, before striking them down with a blast of water.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CursedSkull: Exposed to dark rituals, this skull has begun floating around on its own, chasing the living. Its touch leaves its victims defenseless.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SkeletronHead: The disembodied bones of a former tyrant pulsed with a hatred so strong, it left behind a mighty curse which guards the Dungeon.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_OldMan: This hapless Old Man carries the burden of a heavy curse. It's said at night he transforms into a horrific demon which guards the Dungeon.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Demolitionist: Tread carefully around this dwarf. The Demolitionist is an explosive fanatic and sells dangerous things that go 'Boom!'
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BoneSerpentHead: Mighty serpentine dragons once ruled hell, but long ago shed their obsidian scales. A skeletal husk is all that remains.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Hornet: Aggressive flying insects which swarm the jungle depths. Their venomous barbs discharge over great distances at high velocity.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ManEater: A sharp-toothed plant with a taste for human flesh. It has the ability to hide inside the mud and reach over great distances.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_UndeadMiner: There's evidence of spelunkers having explored the caverns in the past... as well as evidence of them having died doing so.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Tim: An enchanter in life, this funny fellow won't give up his robe or wizard hat without a fight. He prefers warmer caverns.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Bunny: Fuzzy wuzzy creatures that prefer safe, friendly locations.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CorruptBunny: Bunnies are pure beings that normally resist all forms of Corruption, but will succumb under the effects of a Blood Moon.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Harpy: Winged, demi-human women defend their territory against invaders by impaling them with their razor-sharp feathers.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CaveBat: They are small, hard to see, and swiftly flap about in unpredictable ways. They often carry diseases, such as rabies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_KingSlime: Slimes normally aren't intelligent, but occasionally they merge together to become a powerful force to swallow all things.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_JungleBat: These small, annoying creatures aren't to be underestimated. A deadly end awaits for those swarmed by these fangy rodents.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DoctorBones: This particular zombie has a knack for finding historical artifacts, but has a terrible disdain towards snakes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TheGroom: Tall, handsome, and dead. This unlucky fellow did not survive his wedding and is ready to take it out on everyone.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Clothier: Once trapped under a curse, the Clothier is the master of thread. If it's fashion that's desired, he's the man! He talks in a familiar way.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Goldfish: A seemingly ordinary goldfish, until it decides to rain.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Snatcher: A sharp-toothed plant with a taste for human flesh. It has the ability to hide inside the mud and reach over great distances.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CorruptGoldfish: Goldfish mutate and become violent when exposed to a Blood Moon, allowing the Corruption to take hold of them.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Piranha: Just one of these sharp-toothed fish can easily end a life. Luckily, they tend to swarm their victims in large groups! Life is grand.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_LavaSlime: Due to the heat of the underworld, these slimes have taken on the properties of lava. Slaying them is difficult and dangerous.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Hellbat: What's worse than a rabid, fast-flying, and annoying flying rodent? One that is on fire, of course!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Vulture: Built to survive the desert heat, avian scavengers such as these will peck apart those who come near their carrion.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Demon: Demons are the infantry of the underworld. Unlike their lesser brothers, they cast shadow magic rather than hell magic.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BlueJellyfish: That strange tingling sensation in the water may be the unwelcome surging of electrical death from a brainless jellyfish. Swim with care.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PinkJellyfish: That strange tingling sensation in the water may be the unwelcome surging of electrical death from a brainless jellyfish. Swim with care.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Shark: Once these ocean predators catch a whiff of blood, they become relentless and unstoppable in their ravenous pursuit.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_VoodooDemon: Higher ranking demons can possess a voodoo doll of the chosen one, whose soul is linked with the world's guardian himself.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Crab: This hard shelled coastal creature could snip the toes right off a man, among other things. They are not to be trifled with.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DungeonGuardian: A lethal sentry that stands watch over the Dungeon's gates. Those who are deemed unworthy to enter shall not pass!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Antlion: When antlions are nesting, they hide in the surface. To defend their eggs, they projectile vomit hard globs of sand at trespassers.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DungeonSlime: Slimes in the Dungeon became powerful by feeding off the cursed energy throughout the place. They seem particularly attracted to keys.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinScout: The Goblin Army sends lone soldiers out from the beaches to seek out colonies to conquer. They give warning with a tattered sigil.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Bird: A simple white bird which enjoys a calm sunny day.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Pixie: A larger, more luminous form of fairy. Pixies provide the Hallow with more blessed light and aid in the cleansing of the land.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Mummy: With the sands transmogrified by outside forces, those put to rest in the desert, whether good or evil, now rise to maim and kill.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DarkMummy: With the sands transmogrified by outside forces, those put to rest in the desert, whether good or evil, now rise to maim and kill.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_LightMummy: With the sands transmogrified by outside forces, those put to rest in the desert, whether good or evil, now rise to maim and kill.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CorruptSlime: Steeped in the power of Corruption, these slimes can survive being cut apart into smaller pieces, unlike their untainted brethren.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Wraith: Souls belonging to the darkest of hearts were once sealed in the world's core. Now, they roam the night to add to their kind.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CursedHammer: Magicked through the pure hatred of the Corruption, this weapon flails about attempting to smash anything that breathes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_EnchantedSword: Animated by the blessed light of the crystals, it will slice through anything to cleanse the world's evils.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Mimic: Talking to a chest doesn't cause craziness, but if the chest answers back, it may cause death! It still contains rare treasure, regardless!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Unicorn: These majestic single-horned equines storm angrily through the hallowed land in search of lowly intrusions needing to be cleansed away.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_WyvernHead: A colossal dragon-like creature unleashed along with the ancient spirits. It rules the skies with its unrivaled might.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GiantBat: The oversized cousins of Cave Bats, these bats are more dangerous and can confuse their enemies with their bite.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Corruptor: Like a cancer, the putrid creatures born from the Corruption mutate and grow into bigger, more deadly forms which discharge acids.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DiggerHead: Exposure to the effects of ancient magicks flowing throughout the cracks of the world causes unusual rapid growths in giant worms.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SeekerHead: Ancient magicks have unleashed the dark influences that gave birth to the Eater of Worlds, producing smaller, but just as deadly worms.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Clinger: In the depths of the darkest corruption lies cursed-fire belching, betentacled nightmares stretching from the very walls themselves.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_AnglerFish: Some angler fish are content to lie in wait for their prey, but these are perfectly happy to aggressively chase down an underwater meal.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GreenJellyfish: That strange tingling sensation in the water may be the unwelcome surging of electrical death from a brainless jellyfish. Swim with care.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Werewolf: Cursed by the moonlight, these menacing lupines were once human. Now, they feast on their loved ones instinctively.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinTinkerer: Exiled from the rest of goblinkind for being an intelligent pacifist, the Tinkerer sells tools for combining accessories into stronger versions.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Wizard: The Wizard is an absent-minded, demented old man who dabbles in the arcane arts. He sells magical trinkets to train new apprentices.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Clown: His origins unknown, this creepy fiend balances himself on a ball while hurling explosive destruction at everything around him.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GoblinArcher: Lending ranged support to the Goblin Army, archers keep a distance and pick off distracted and overwhelmed foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_WallofFlesh: Serving as the world's core and guardian, the towering demon lord exists to keep powerful ancient spirits sealed away.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TheHungry: The Wall of Flesh's many mouths, attached by bloody veins. As a last resort, they can tear away and hungrily chase down threats.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TheHungryII: The Wall of Flesh's many mouths, attached by bloody veins. As a last resort, they can tear away and hungrily chase down threats.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_LeechHead: A worm-like parasite spit forth from the Wall of Flesh, filled with the lifeblood of its host. This blood has healing properties.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ChaosElemental: Once living beings infused by the blessing, they erratically make chase with an uncontrollable surge of luminous power.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Slimer: The Slimer has become airborne with wings of unknown origin. The wings are easily knocked off with force, depriving it of its flight.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Gastropod: Touched by the blessing, these nocturnal slimes evolved into a levitating snail-like creature which spits powerful beams of light.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Mechanic: The Mechanic was imprisoned for her aptitude in engineering. She sells wiring and tools for putting together anything imaginable.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Retinazer: Belonging to a pair of mechanically recreated Eyes of Cthulhu, this one focuses its energy into firing powerful lasers.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Spazmatism: Belonging to a pair of mechanically recreated Eyes of Cthulhu, this one chases at high speed, exhaling cursed flames.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SkeletronPrime: Mechanically reconstructed for reviving Cthulhu, this Skeletron has more arms than ever before, and a variety of fierce weapons.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BaldZombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_WanderingEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TheDestroyer: A mechanical simulacrum of Cthulhu's spine decorated in laser-armed probes, which detach from its body when damaged.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IlluminantBat: Blessed with the prismatic light of the Hallow, the Illuminant Bats are a vibrant pink blur arcing across the darkness of the Underground.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IlluminantSlime: Slimes exposed to the light of the Hallow's crystals begin to emit that very same light, glowing brightly in the darkness.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Probe: A singular probe detached from the Destroyer's body serves as a remote laser battery, often in a swarm of other probes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PossessedArmor: Whatever possessed this suit of armor to suddenly walk about and start killing everyone? It lacks a corporeal body.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ToxicSludge: Distantly related to the common slime, the Toxic Sludge takes down its prey with potent toxins and a disarmingly toothy smile.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SantaClaus: Only present during a specific time of year, Santa Claus makes a big entrance and an even bigger, rather explosive exit. Ho! Ho! Ho!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SnowmanGangsta: While the world's inhabitants celebrate festivities, gangster snowmen party by slaying everyone with their tommy guns.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_MisterStabby: This stone-cold, yet maniacal gangster never snuffs the celebrating do-gooders without bringing along his 'Lil' Pokey'.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SnowBalla: Nobody underestimates the throwing arm on this disturbed member of the snowman mafioso. He's a real slugger!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IceSlime: Slimes that spent too long in arctic temperatures may begin to partially freeze, developing a shifting layer of ice on their surface.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Penguin: Penguins make their home in the coldest regions of the world, waddling around looking for tasty fish.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PenguinBlack: Penguins make their home in the coldest regions of the world, waddling around looking for tasty fish.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IceBat: As if bats weren't enough of a nuisance already, Ice Bats can freeze flesh solid with a touch, leaving their prey defenseless.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Lavabat: What's worse than a rabid, fast-flying, and annoying flying rodent? One that is on fire, of course!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GiantFlyingFox: An oversized cousin of the bat found only in the Jungle, giant flying foxes hunt the night skies looking for prey.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GiantTortoise: No one takes the giant tortoises seriously. Not until they come hurtling through the air, a spinning, spiky ball of death.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IceTortoise: Like their jungle cousins, ice tortoises are an unexpectedly serious threat, possessing surprising speed and mobility.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Wolf: Living in the harshest of climates, these savage lupines hunt in the dark of night desperately for sustenance.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_RedDevil: Conjuring potent spears of dark magic, these elite demons are a serious threat to any who dare enter their abode.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Arapaima: These enormous fish thrive in the jungle waters near veins of unstable magicks, which make them unusually strong and hostile.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Vampire: Whether he is a man who turns into a bat, or a bat who turns into a man, one thing is for sure: he's out for blood!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Truffle: Harnessing the hidden power of the glowing mushroom, the Truffle forges weapons and tools exclusively in his mushroom home.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ZombieEskimo: Zombies found in snow biomes are often found bundled up in winter clothing. It doesn't help them any, they are still dead cold!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Frankenstein: Built from parts of deceased Terrarians, this stout monster resulted from a crazy man's desire to create life with his own hands.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_WallCreeperWall: They have eight legs, eight eyes, and eight ways to cocoon and feast upon an unsuspecting victim.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SwampThing: Creeping from the depths of the darkest swamps, this algae-dripped beast desires to drown away anyone in his path.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_UndeadViking: Long before there were pirates, stories tell of powerful vikings who raged the seas. Their remains roam the icy caverns below.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CorruptPenguin: During a Blood Moon, the normally docile penguins fall under the hostile influence of the Corruption.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IceElemental: Water elementals become icy when dense strong magicks accumulate in the coldest places. Their frosty shards freeze all.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PigronCorruption: This elusive dragon-pig hybrid has excellent stealth capabilities despite its rotund figure. It is uncertain how they came to exist.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PigronHallow: This elusive dragon-pig hybrid has excellent stealth capabilities despite its rotund figure. It is uncertain how they came to exist.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_RuneWizard: Tim's more powerful and much better-looking older brother. He, too, prefers the heat, but not excessively.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Crimera: The most common horror to be born from the Crimson, it seeks to consume pure things with unrelenting hunger.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Herpling: These hyper, demented, slug-like fiends serve the crimson horde with an unstoppable appetite for blood and flesh.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_AngryTrapper: When a Man Eater consumes enough human flesh, it undergoes a cocoon-like metamorphosis into a far deadlier form.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_MossHornet: The empowered flora of the Jungle has merged with these species of Hornet, strengthening their exoskeletons and stingers.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Derpling: These large, sapphire-shelled fleas leap around incessantly. They can drain the blood content of one man within seconds.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Steampunker: The Steampunker has a particular taste for steam-fueled machinery and gadgets. She sells her gizmos with an endearing accent.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CrimsonAxe: Ensorcelled by the Crimson collective, this weapon moves about and chops its enemies by its own will.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PigronCrimson: This elusive dragon-pig hybrid has excellent stealth capabilities despite its rotund figure. It is uncertain how they came to exist.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_FaceMonster: It would be unwise to face off with one of these unfeeling, hungry mutations. Their mouths are large enough to devour all things.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_FloatyGross: These buoyant terrors of the darkest crimson depths most definitely, without question, are both floaty and gross.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Crimslime: Taking on the consistency of congealed blood and flesh, Crimslimes seek out and digest more raw material for the Crimson.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SpikedIceSlime: This Ice Slime has large ice shards in its mass from excessive exposure to the cold. Somehow, it is able to launch these at its prey.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SnowFlinx: A strange, round furry mammal with an unusually large, protruding nose. They are extremely lightweight.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PincushionZombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SlimedZombie: Sometimes, a slime's victim will turn into a zombie mid-digestion. Walking around like that is quite awkward for both parties.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SwampZombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_TwiggyZombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CataractEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SleepyEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DialatedEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_GreenEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PurpleEye: That suspicious feeling of being watched may very well come true in the dark of night, when Cthulhu's minions roam the skies.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_LostGirl: Naked and afraid, this girl stands still, deep in the world, as if waiting for someone to rescue her and lead her to the surface.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Nymph: Masterfully deceives explorers by posing as a lost girl, then attacks with ferocious might, blood-lust in her eyes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ArmoredViking: The most elite vikings were worthy of the strongest armor. It seems that it wasn't terribly effective, given their state now.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Lihzahrd: A reclusive race of reptilian folk found exclusively in the mysterious jungle Temple. They look primitive, but are quite advanced.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_FemaleZombie: Leaving doors open may be an invitation for shambling brain-eaters to enter the home, and nobody likes that.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_HeadacheSkeleton: Who needs muscles, skin, or even eyeballs? Skeletons get by with just the bones on their back, just as deadly as more fleshy foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_MisassembledSkeleton: Who needs muscles, skin, or even eyeballs? Skeletons get by with just the bones on their back, just as deadly as more fleshy foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PantlessSkeleton: Who needs muscles, skin, or even eyeballs? Skeletons get by with just the bones on their back, just as deadly as more fleshy foes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SpikedJungleSlime: Frequent consumption of the Jungle's toxins and thorns has resulted in a slime covered in venomous spikes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Moth: Rarely, exposure to jungle toxins causes certain moths to mutate to enormous size. They release a valuable dust on death.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_IcyMerman: Mermen rarely stray far from the ocean. Those that do can become lost, wander into cold caverns, and become icy undead fish men.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_DyeTrader: Eccentric and rather snobby to a fault, the Dye Trader has expensive tastes. He is passionate about the materials used in the dyes he sells.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PartyGirl: Positive beyond comprehension, the Party Girl will use any excuse to celebrate. She sells party favors and flashy things.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Cyborg: The Cyborg was built with the combined efforts of the Mechanic and the Steampunker to aid in rocket science and world defense.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Bee: Found in hives and nests all throughout the jungle, these tiny pests will swarm an adventurer at every turn.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_BeeSmall: Found in hives and nests all throughout the jungle, these tiny pests will swarm an adventurer at every turn.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PirateDeckhand: They are either washing the deck of their ship of seaweed and ale, or wiping the dirt with the faces of unsuspecting Terrarians.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PirateCorsair: Once mercenaries from a distant land, Corsairs brandish deadly scimitars with unyielding skill and a cut-throat agenda.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PirateDeadeye: Nobody knows if 'Dead Eye' refers to their precise aim, or the fact that one of their eyes is indeed 'dead'... like their targets.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PirateCrossbower: Some wee lasses aren't content staying at port waiting for their men to return from a raid, so they join in on the deadly fun!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_PirateCaptain: A pirate captain's love for riches is only rivaled by his obsession with heavy gunpowder and large, rampart-shattering cannons!
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CochinealBeetle: Found in deep, dark caverns, these large beetles are sought out for the deep, blood-red secretions stored in their scaly exoskeleton.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_CyanBeetle: Hardy to extremely cold temperatures, these beetles contain a desired bluish fluid which can be used to dye textiles.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_LacBeetle: These scaly insects thrive in thick subterranean foliage. Their secretions stain many materials in a beautiful violet color.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_SeaSnail: This unusually large snail makes its home deep in the ocean. Its mucus can be manufactured into a purple dye.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_Squid: A betentacled marine creature which discharges a thick, black ink when threatened. The ink is collected for aesthetic purposes.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_QueenBee: This highly aggressive monstrosity responds violently when her larva is disturbed; the honey-laden hives are her home turf.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_ZombieRaincoat: Some zombies never leave home without their trusty raincoat. Comfy and dry, they pursue human flesh no matter the weather.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_FlyingFish: Certain species of fish gain the most peculiar abilities when it rains. They only like one thing about land-dwellers: their flesh.
Bestiary_FlavorText.npc_UmbrellaSlime: The previous owner of this umbrella learned the hard way: umbrellas are good protection against rain, but not against slime.
